name: 2+PV
purpose: Spend a third round only to interrogate the post-recovery state after a nontrivial agreed recovery, rather than using another pre-recovery snapshot to choose the recovery.
state_machine: Run mandatory acquisition rounds R1 and R2.
Any center flag or detected ancilla loss in R1/R2 -> HOLD; detected data loss -> QUARANTINE.
If complete center frames b1 and b2 disagree -> HOLD. No resolver snapshot is used.
If b1=b2=b, apply the frozen Pauli-frame recovery selected by b.
If b=0000, ACCEPT immediately; no verification round is executed.
If b!=0000, execute one conditional post-recovery verification round V.
Any center flag or detected ancilla loss in V -> HOLD; detected data loss -> QUARANTINE.
Accept only if V measures center syndrome 0000 relative to the updated Pauli frame.

information_order.strictly_stronger_than_temporal_repetiti: The optional round observes the state after the recovery map. Two pre-recovery histories that select the same recovery can be distinguished if their residual post-recovery syndromes differ.

fault_semantics.conditional_exposure: verification locations exist only on trajectories with complete unflagged loss-free b1=b2!=0000

evaluation_freeze.success_target: Reduce at least one of the 2+0 degree-two accepted-logical coefficients without increasing the other, while retaining first-order acceptance strictly above fixed 2+1 in at least one nonnegative fault direction.
evaluation_freeze.no_go_target: If both accepted-logical degree-two coefficients exceed or equal 2+0 with at least one strict increase, AUTO_FREEZE v0.3 for the intended adaptive-quality target.
